categories.main_business_segments: Ji'an Mankun Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of printed circuit boards (PCBs). Its main product lines include single/double-sided and multilayer rigid PCBs, serving sectors such as communication electronics, consumer electronics, industrial control and security, and automotive electronics. The company also invests in high-end PCB products like HDI boards and automotive electronic PCBs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including high-density interconnect (HDI), high-layer count multilayer boards (18 layers and above), thick copper, embedded copper, and high-frequency/high-speed boards. It emphasizes automated, digital, and intelligent production methods supported by MES, EAP, QMS, APS, WMS, and AGV logistics systems. The firm holds 147 patents and has developed proprietary technologies for high-temperature resin inks, automotive PCBs, and other specialized PCB products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span major brands in communication electronics (e.g., TP-LINK, Tenda, Foxconn), consumer electronics (e.g., Gree, JD.com, Visionox), industrial control and security (e.g., Delta Electronics, Hikvision, Datalogic), and automotive electronics (e.g., Desay SV, Marelli, Anhui Zhijia). The company targets markets including routers, 5G base stations, LED displays, smart home devices, industrial automation, and traditional and new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales (over 80% of revenue) and exports accounting for around 17-18%. It has subsidiaries and production bases in Shenzhen, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Thailand, with ongoing investment in a new production facility in Thailand to better serve overseas customers and optimize capacity layout.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ji'an Mankun Technology operates in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, focusing on PCB manufacturing as a critical intermediate product that connects electronic components. It procures raw materials such as copper foil, prepregs, and inks from upstream suppliers and sells finished PCBs downstream to electronic device manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in automotive electronics, high-end consumer electronics, and communication electronics, focusing on HDI technology, high-layer PCBs, high-frequency boards, and specialized substrates like ceramic and thick copper. It invests in intelligent manufacturing, automation, and digitalization to enhance production efficiency and product quality. Talent acquisition and innovation in process optimization and new product development are key strategic pillars.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized PCB products based on client design specifications. The company follows a direct sales model predominantly, with a small portion through distributors. It also receives government subsidies and investment income, but product sales constitute the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ji'an Mankun Technology is recognized as a leading domestic PCB manufacturer, ranked 49th among comprehensive PCB companies and 27th among domestic PCB firms in China. It competes in a highly fragmented and competitive PCB industry with many players expanding capacity. The company leverages its technological capabilities, quality certifications, and strong customer relationships to maintain and grow its market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.27 billion, a 4.17% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders around RMB 106.5 million, slightly down by 2.99%. Total assets grew by 22.24% to RMB 2.78 billion. The company is in a growth phase, investing heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, with ongoing projects expected to enhance future revenue and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ji'an Mankun Technology emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and customized PCB solutions with advanced technological capabilities such as HDI and high-layer boards. Its value proposition includes strong R&D, comprehensive quality management systems, and excellent customer service, enabling long-term partnerships with leading global brands. The company also focuses on intelligent manufacturing and cost control to offer competitive pricing and timely delivery.
